text:
maria: kicking off the funnel rollout for ff:llm-response-opt at 23:00 UTC. main goal is to watch latency and hallucination rate. short soak, then 10/30/60 percent over 30m windows.
aj: ack. what's the guardrail numbers we care about?
noah: latency 95p increase > 40ms or error rate > 0.5% => immediate rollback. quality: hallucination rate measured by eval-set > 1.2x baseline => pause.
kira: got it. I'll watch traces and sampling. turning on extra trace-level logging for the first 10m.
maria: deploy-bot schedule set. will pin runtime to v2.3.1 during the rollout so we don't get mixed kernels.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: ff:llm-response-opt -> cohorts: internal-1 (5%), beta (10%), public-1 (30%), public-2 (60%). start=1707500000, step=10m, soak=5m per step. pinned_version=v2.3.1. link: https://releases.redwood/example/rls-482
aj: small note — please add the rollout tag to the release notes so support can see the change window.
maria: done. release notes snippet: "llm-response-opt: opt-in filter and KV cache improvements; rollout with pinned runtime v2.3.1; watch latency and hallucination metric HL_RATE."
noah: quick commands if we need to yank:
```
# immediate full disable
/feature toggle ff:llm-response-opt off --force
# drain cohorts back to baseline
/feature set-cohort ff:llm-response-opt public-2 0
```
kira: will keep a small sample of outputs in #model-audit-logs for drift inspection.
sre-bot: alert rule created: alert/latency-95p > 40ms for ff:llm-response-opt (5m eval) -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.
maria: timeline check: we have a 01:00 UTC change window end; if we hit any guardrail we'll stop and leave at last safe percentage, then schedule a rollback or patch.
aj: if we pause, do we unpin? i'd prefer to keep pin until we have a signoff from ML.
maria: agree — keep pinned. only unpin after post-rollout verification.
noah: during the first 10m, i'll run a small A/B eval harness and post aggregate HL_RATE every 2m.
kira: if we see drift, tag examples with `#rollforward-candidate` and export.
maria: ok starting in 2m. @deploy-bot please announce each cohort change to this thread.
deploy-bot: cohort internal-1 enabled (5%) at 1707500120. rolllog: cohort->internal-1, pinned=v2.3.1.
noah: sampling 1000 outputs now -> HL_RATE baseline=0.7% current=0.8% (noisy).
aj: small blip, watching.
kira: traces look normal, tail latency stable.
maria: hold decisions: if HL_RATE persists >1.2x baseline for 3 consecutive 2m reports, we pause and open a patch ticket.
noah: noted. I'll post the 2m aggregates here.
sre-bot: heartbeat: no alerts.
maria: thanks team — will update on each step. remember support incident channel is #support-watch for customer reports. :eyes:
